design_note: Quantify progressive disclosure without calling executable helpers free. A capacity tray includes the chosen instructions, resource and invocation/result overhead while leaving unrelated procedures and unread helper source outside the model call.

source.title: Specification
source.concept: Skill information is disclosed progressively: discovery metadata, activated instructions, then supporting resources when the task requires them.
source.scope: Original token allocation and helper execution policy are constructed. They are not specification limits, measured savings or permission granted by the folder format.

lesson.title: Unread helper code can still create token overhead
lesson.intro: A refund kit uses a 6000-token envelope. Helper code runs in an authorized sandbox; the model receives its invocation and result, not its full source. All values are constructed.

excluded.label: Helper source: 4000 tokens
excluded.reason: Not read by model; its call/result counted

read: The serialized input occupies 4000 tokens; output capacity reserves another 2000.
The selected resource, invocation and helper result occupy the 1600-token segment.
Unread source code remains an executable artifact governed by sandbox and permission policy.
lesson.question: Does keeping 4000 tokens of helper source outside this call make the helper token overhead zero?
lesson.answer: No. Its invocation and returned content still occupy part of the 1600-token segment. Only the unread source body stays outside this model call. Execution resources are accounted separately, and the helper remains subject to authorization, sandboxing and its effect contract.
lesson.takeaway: Progressive disclosure avoids unnecessary source loading, not all information or execution cost.
lesson.assumption: Constructed provider envelope includes protocol overhead and no separate reasoning reserve. Source code is executed without model inspection; output capacity is not input.
